reviews.text: Highly recommend LJR for all your landscaping needs, including pavers and plantings! Lino and his team are expert and highly professional, blending masterful work with dependability and friendly service. Prices are very fair for the excellent work they do.

LJR really helped turn our yard around. Did a full clean-up, weeding mulch and aerated and seeding on the whole lawn. Our grass is looking better than ever can't wait to see it in the spring. I would definitely recommend them as they are professional, on time, and does an amazing job!
